articles.title: 水月雨 ddHiFi Blue Rose 便携解码耳放发售：双 CS43198 芯片，1399 元全球限量 1000 套
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 4 日消息，ddHiFi 与水月雨联名的 Blue Rose 便携解码耳放（型号 MD-DA-016）今日正式发售，定价为 1399 元，全球限量 1000 套。京东水月雨 × ddHiFi Blue Rose 便携解码耳放无损小尾巴 HIFI 发烧 TypeC 转接 3.5/4.4 Blue Rose1399 元直达链接这是一款基于 ddHiFi TC44 GRIP 开发设计的特别产品，依托其成熟的硬件配置与制造工艺，由水月雨与 ddHiFi 共同进行再设计与调校，从内至外均有不同。外观方面，Blue Rose 以「暮蓝的玫瑰」为主题意象，采用水月友希 · 暮蓝特别主题配色与面板。面板以高品质铝合金为基材，采用多色阳极氧化 + 精密雕刻工艺，细节纹路清晰可辨，多色阳极氧化工艺还可在表面形成稳定保护层，在一定程度上耐磨损、防指纹。产品尺寸约 62mm × 28mm × 10mm（不含线缆、引磁片）。核心硬件上，该产品搭载两颗 Cirrus Logic CS43198 旗舰解码芯片与两颗 SGM8262-2 独立运放芯片，搭配高效电源及充电管理芯片，经过精细化调音调校，呈现出舒适、细腻、大气的纯净听感。Blue Rose 的 USB 界面芯片可兼容市面上大部分手机、平板、电脑设备，能够硬解播放高达 32Bit / 768kHz PCM 音源以及原生 DSD 256 1Bit 音源。输出性能方面，Blue Rose 新增物理高 / 低增益开关设计。高增益模式下，4.4mm 平衡接口输出电平可达 4Vrms，32Ω 负载下不失真输出功率可达 500mW，可驱动市面常见入耳式耳塞，甚至可驱动头戴式耳机；动态范围高达 130dB，带来近乎「零」底噪的超大动态表现。音质指标上，Blue Rose 的失真低至 0.00019%，信纳比超过 114dB，忠实还原 HiFi 音质。Blue Rose 配备双耳机输出接口：4.4mm 平衡耳机接口可发挥满幅音频性能，3.5mm 单端耳机接口则具备更广泛的兼容性。其中 3.5mm 单端接口还支持 CTIA 标准线控麦克风，可搭配带线控麦克风的线缆，满足游戏、通话、直播、K 歌等各类场景的使用需求。Blue Rose 内置第二代在线交互式 DSP，通过全新升级的 MOONDROP APP（仅支持安卓版本），用户可在专业调音界面对内置 DSP 参数化均衡器进行自定义调试，滤波器类型、频点、增益、Q 值等参数均可自由控制，并可参照原始频响曲线作为调音基准。水月雨 APP 内置调音分享与下载社区，用户可以上传自己制作的调音分享给其他用户，也可以下载其他用户或官方制作的调音配置，并固定在 Blue Rose 的硬件中；同时支持自行上传的社区化频响库，用户上传的频响数据经审核后将录入在线数据库，即便使用非水月雨品牌耳机，也能便捷获取调音所需的基础频响参考。对于非安卓系统设备，Blue Rose 还支持更专业的 WEB 调试平台，提供比手机端更专业、完整且精确的调音界面，账号与数据库均与 APP 端共通。为解决边听歌边充电的需求，Blue Rose 配备额外的 PD 快充 USB-C 接口，使用时可通过支持 PD 标准协议的充电器为手机充电，最高支持 60W 大功率充电（实际功率取决于设备兼容的 PD 协议与充电设备，实测搭配 iPhone 16 Pro 约 25W、安卓手机约 10-30W、部分平板或笔记本可达约 60W）。便携性方面，Blue Rose 标配三款专属引磁片：两款长度不同的磁吸式引磁片与一款背胶式引磁片，均内置强磁铁并带有专属图案，只需将引磁片贴附 / 吸附于手机背部，把 Blue Rose 底部凹槽对准引磁片即可轻松固定随行。此外，Blue Rose 还配备采样率指示灯：蓝色表示 PCM 解码 ≤ 48 kHz，绿色表示 PCM 解码 ≥ 88.2 kHz，白色表示原生 DSD 输出。IT之家附详细参数如下：京东 11.11 无门槛红包 面额至高 26888 元，每天抽 3 次：点此抽红包。淘宝 11.11 无门槛红包 面额至高 26888 元，每天抽 1 次：点此抽红包。

articles.title: 7-Eleven 日本公司送货上门服务遭非法访问，超 16 万条客户信息外泄
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 4 日消息，据共同社报道，便利店企业 7-Eleven 日本公司 3 日宣布，送货上门服务“7NOW”的配送业务外包方遭遇非法访问，总计逾 16 万条客户信息外泄。泄露的信息包括姓名、住址、电话号码等，不涉及信用卡信息和密码。据该公司透露，1 日查明外包方遭受非法访问，3 日确认 7-Eleven 部分用户信息外泄。据悉，7-Eleven 的送货上门服务未因此受到影响，用户仍可照常使用。官方将通过短信方式，依次向已经登记的电话号码联系涉及对象。据IT之家此前报道，而在今年 4 月，7-Eleven 就遭遇了臭名昭著的黑客团伙 ShinyHunters 攻击，超过 18.3 万名用户的个人信息被窃取。2022 年 8 月，7-Eleven 丹麦公司就曾遭到勒索软件攻击，部分系统被加密，导致约 175 家门店被迫暂停营业。相关阅读：《7-Eleven 便利店遭黑客团伙 ShinyHunters 入侵，超 18.3 万名用户个人信息泄露》

articles.title: 华邦 2026Q3 营收同比大增 278.2%，核准 713.63 亿新台币高雄扩产计划
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 4 日消息，中国台湾地区利基型存储器制造商华邦电子 (Winbond) 昨日公布了其 2026 年第 3 季度运营表现：合并营收：823.31 亿新台币，同比增长 278.2%毛利率：70.6%；归母税后净利润：354.22 亿新台币每股净收益：7.58 新台币从产品类别来看，客制化内存营收占比 58%，闪存贡献 32%，逻辑和其它各占 9% 和 1%；从应用类别来看，通讯电子占比为 31%，消费电子、车用及工业用相关各占 26%，计算机相关则是 17%。华邦电子是全球最大的 NOR 闪存制造商，其 SLC NAND 闪存则位居世界第三。该企业预计闪存价格仍有上行空间，而 DRAM 内存的价格也不至于下跌。华邦电子同日通过一项 713.63 亿新台币的投资计划，拟于南部科学园区高雄园区扩建 12 英寸晶圆厂并购置生产设备。这也就是此前提到的 Module B 项目。此轮扩建预计 2026 年 12 月 29 日动工，有望 2 年内装机，2029 年小规模量产，2030 年放量。

articles.title: 消息称极氪计划推出硬派越野 SUV：对标奔驰大 G，预计 2028-2029 年量产
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 4 日消息，“未来汽车 Daily”今天（4 日）上午援引知情人士消息称，极氪内部正在筹划一款方盒子硬派越野 SUV，并已向多家供应商匹配需求。极氪内部并没有给这款硬派越野 SUV 设立代号，从供应商的口径来讲，他们将这个项目称为“极氪对标奔驰大 G 的车型方案”。据悉，该车型目前仍在做供应商的匹配，尚未正式立项，按照进度来推测，这款对标大 G 的车型方案预计会在 2028 年 —2029 年量产。另据知情人士透露，该车尚未正式确定造型，对标奔驰大 G 的策略则是用“承载式 / 半承载 + 电驱独立控制 + 空悬行程 + 智能脱困”的策略实现“新豪华越野”性能。早在今年 5 月，极氪国际副总裁陈禹曾透露，“硬派越野是明确方向之一。与此同时，主打运动性能的轿车乃至跑车也是另一个方向。”报道认为，其核心目标是承接预算在 50 万元以上、不满足于常规城市豪华，同时想要兼顾日常舒适与轻越野能力的细分人群。据IT之家了解，今年 10 月，吉利银河推出了硬派越野 SUV 战舰 700，定价 18.98 万至 37.98 万元，高配版本甚至搭载了“应急浮水”功能。

articles.title: SIA & WSTS：全球 2026Q3 半导体销售额 5177 亿美元，环比增幅 24.1%
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 4 日消息，美国半导体行业协会 (SIA) 当地时间 3 日表示，根据世界半导体贸易统计组织 (WSTS) 编制的数据，全球半导体销售额在 2026 年第 3 季度达到 5,177 亿美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 3.46 万亿元人民币），环比增长 24.1%。各主要区域市场的半导体销售额均在 9 月出现了强劲增长，即使是相对最为弱势的日本市场也有 73.4% 的显著增幅，美洲的同比增幅达到惊人的 191.7%。▲ 图源：WSTSSIA 总裁兼首席执行官 Michael Robbins 表示：今年第三季度，全球芯片市场实现了大幅增长，全球销售额连续第三个季度环比增长超过 20%。所有主要区域市场的半导体销售额同比均保持强劲势头，这凸显了该行业的全球影响力，以及其在推动创新、提高生产力和增强经济竞争力方面不可或缺的作用。参考Global Semiconductor Sales Increase 24.1% from Q2 2026 to Q3 2026

articles.title: 全球首个千公里空芯光纤双向实时传输验证，中国电信、长飞公司、中兴通讯联合完成
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 4 日消息，中国电信研究院 11 月 2 日宣布，全国重点实验室共建单位中国电信研究院、长飞公司联合中兴通讯，共同完成全球首个千公里空芯光纤双向实时传输验证：在 1007.48 公里空芯光纤链路上，实现扩展 C+L 波段单波 800Gb/s（PCS-16QAM 调制）单纤双向传输，总容量达 128Tb/s，将空芯光纤实时传输的距离纪录推至新的高度，标志着我国在下一代光通信关键核心技术上再获里程碑式突破。⁠本次试验在光纤端，通过光纤制备工艺优化消除了扩展 C+L 波段内 CO₂、CO 气体线吸收（GLA），攻克了 GLA 劣化传输性能的核心技术难题；在设备端，结合空芯光纤损耗特性、放大器工作特性，摒弃高功率放大器，选用常规输出功率商用放大器，实现单波 800G 满波传输系统性能最优；在系统端，搭配轻量化发端预均衡方案，保障扩展 C+L 全波段信道性能平稳均衡，建立端到端反射和模间干涉影响评估模型，并完成波段掉波极端运维场景验证，证实该场景下系统无性能劣化。本次试验取得了三项标志性进展：一是创下全球最长的空芯光纤点到点非环回实时传输距离纪录，每跨保留≥3dB 的损耗余量，且留有≥3dB 的 OSNR 系统维护余量；二是首次完成千公里级空芯光纤单纤双向实时传输，验证了长距离双向传输的可能性，反射带来的 OSNR 劣化为 0.5dB~4dB 不等；三是构建了目前全球最长的扩展 C+L 波段无 GLA 的空芯光纤传输链路，实现千公里空芯光纤链路扩展 C+L 波段无 GLA。IT之家从公告了解到，本次试验的成功，为利用空芯光纤基于高阶调制格式系统构建大带宽、长距离、低时延的骨干网络提供了切实可行的技术依据。

articles.title: 比亚迪新车型确认 11 月 27 日广州车展首发，预计为全新一代比亚迪汉
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 4 日消息，比亚迪王朝网销售事业部总经理路天 11 月 2 日公布，王朝网 10 月销量达到 203,040 辆，为其今年首次站上 20 万辆台阶。路天同时宣布，11 月广州车展将推出一款“用户呼声很高的车型”。同时，比亚迪第三代唐 8 系大五座科技旗舰 SUV 正在上市筹备中，展车已经陆续到店。虽然路天没有透露关于新车的任何信息，但结合最近工信部新车申报但没发布以及“用户呼声很高”这一特点来看，这款新车大概率会是全新一代比亚迪汉。新一代比亚迪汉已在工信部第 412 批新车申报目录中完成申报，共涉及四款车型，包括三款纯电版本与一款插混版本。新车车身长宽高为 5156/1969/1507（1492）mm，轴距 3030mm。对比现款汉，车长增加 161mm，宽度增加 59mm，轴距增加 110mm。车头造型饱满圆润，配备贯穿式前大灯，车头顶端搭载激光雷达。纯电版本提供三种动力配置。245kW 后驱入门版搭载型号 TZ205QYS 永磁同步单电机，峰值功率 245kW，最高车速 240km/h，整备质量 2005kg；300kW 高性能后驱版搭载 TZ205QYD 永磁同步电机，峰值功率 300kW，最高车速同样为 240km/h，整备质量 2125kg。此外还有一款双电机四驱版，前电机峰值功率 200kW、后电机 320kW，综合功率 520kW，最高车速 270km/h。插混版本搭载型号 BYD472ZQB 的 1.5T 发动机，发动机最大功率 115kW，匹配峰值功率 200kW 的永磁同步驱动电机，最高车速 200km/h。新车标配全景天幕，可选装不同前后部造型、轮圈、门把手及黑化装饰等。第二十四届广州国际车展定于 2026 年 11 月 27 日至 12 月 6 日举办，11 月 27 日为媒体日（媒体日通常为新车首发亮相的集中时段），IT之家届时将为大家带来更多详细报道。相关阅读：《全新比亚迪汉申报：纯电插混多版本，车长 5156mm 轴距 3030mm》

articles.content: IT之家 11 月 4 日消息，韩媒《每日经济》当地时间昨日报道称，三星电子晶圆代工业务计划在其美国得克萨斯州泰勒市集群的第二晶圆厂为 AMD 等客户生产 HBM 基础裸片 (Base Die)。IT之家注意到，三星晶圆代工泰勒集群的首座晶圆厂将在 2026 年内投运；第二晶圆厂则将在本月动工，预计 2030 年投运。三星晶圆代工主要向自家存储器业务供应 HBM 基础裸片。自 HBM4 世代开始，内存制造商的自有工艺逐渐无法满足 HBM 堆栈底层与 XPU 通信的基础裸片的性能需求，而未来定制 HBM 还要将部分 XPU 功能卸载到基础裸片上，这导致内存制造商开始向外部先进制程代工企业提供基础裸片制造订单。业内人士认为，三星晶圆代工泰勒第二晶圆厂制造的 HBM 基础裸片除流向 AMD 外，也可能被用于博通为客户打造的 AI ASIC。参考https://www.mk.co.kr/news/business/12195087

articles.title: ROG XBOX 掌机 X 20 周年版上手：一次补齐遗憾的升级，体验更加出色
articles.content: 去年这个时候，华硕和微软联合推出了一款 ROG XBOX 掌机 X，当时它舒适的人体工学设计，出色的屏幕素质、性能和散热体验、大厂联合定制 UI 就获得了外界的一致好评。时隔一年，在 ROG 品牌成立 20 周年之际，华硕又给广大玩家带来了 ROG XBOX 掌机 X 20 周年版，它可不是简单的换皮改色，而是在硬件上由内而外进行了全面升级。IT之家最近拿到了这款新品进行了体验，借此机会，我们就来聊聊升级后的 ROG XBOX 掌机 X 20 周年版表现究竟如何。一、外观升级这次的 ROG XBOX 掌机 X 20 周年版虽然在机身造型和按键布局上没有变化，但整体涂装细节做了定制化升级，这点倒是很像微软。首先就是机身换成了黑透底色，通过外壳可以隐约看到机身内部的一些电子元件和 PCB，特别是背部外壳可直观展现内部两个不小的散热风扇和顶部出风鳍片，质感拉满。外壳内层还做了很多类似电路管线的骨架纹理设计，视觉上更有机械感和科技感，还能作为外壳加强筋存在，一举两得。再来就是无处不在金色点缀设计，比如正面屏幕左右两侧上方的 4 个快捷按键，左右双摇杆的金色 RGB 光环。机身内部风扇外壳 + 热管 + 散热鳍片一整套做成了金色，标志性的斜切分割线也改为金色，左下角还新增了一块金色的 20 周年纪念徽章，黑金双色互相搭配，一实一透，尽显轻奢。当然，标志性的 XBOX 手柄同款握把设计也非常吸睛，表面做了防滑纹理，握持起来更加舒适、汗手也不易打滑和出现粘滞感。顶部的四个扳机按键面积够大，按压反馈和阻尼调校都是第一梯队，还做了人体工学微调，ABXY 按键也做了表面弧度优化。第二个升级点是摇杆和十字键，ROG XBOX 掌机 X 20 周年版这次换成了 TMR 摇杆，它继承了霍尔摇杆的耐磨和防漂移特性，使用寿命更长，灵敏度和输出信号表现更好，功耗还更低，适合需要高强度操作的游戏或微小精确操作的游戏，比如 FPS 游戏、格斗游戏、赛车游戏、硬核平台跳跃游戏等，不过摇杆的蘑菇头很难做出偏软手感，还是推荐大家买一副摇杆帽搭配使用。十字键采用可变式设计，可在 4 向和 8 向之间进行切换，格斗 / 2D 横版街机游戏操作上限更高。第三个升级是 ROG XBOX 掌机 X 20 周年版的屏幕，依旧是 1080P + 120Hz 的显示组合，但尺寸由 7 英寸升级到了 7.4 英寸，顶部黑边更窄，材质也由 LCD 升级到了 OLED，还是 ROG 最高规格的星云原画屏，支持 HDR。升级后的屏幕表面采用 DXC 抗反射涂层工艺，搭配 OLED 屏幕的广色域和 HDR 效果，画面对比度、色彩表现、峰值亮度以及响应时间全面提升，屏占比也更高，玩起游戏来更加沉浸。新版掌机还重做了内部散热，散热鳍片面积增加 11%，新款液态轴承风扇风量提升约 20%，优化了内吹设计，三相风道可吹透处理器、散热鳍片和内部屏幕区域，以换取更低的机身表面温度，长时间游玩性能释放更稳定，屏幕区域不烫手。总的来说，ROG XBOX 掌机 X 20 周年版在外观和硬件上相比去年推出的标准版做了很多改进和升级，整体使用体验会更好，由此换来的是机身净重的增加，新版机器重量为 756g 相比标准版重了 41g，好在整机重量是均匀分摊的，实际握持起来并不会觉得明显增重。另外，我们手上这个版本的包装内还附送了一个环保材质的掌机支架，以及一个线充一体的方形黑色 65W USB-C 口电源适配器。二、系统交互由于这台掌机是由 ROG 和微软 XBOX 团队合作开发的，因此在系统 UI 和功能交互上，拥有 2 套定制的界面和功能。首先系统底层是基于完整的 Windows 11 articles.title: 微软 Xbox 首位首席运营官 Helen Chiang 确认离职：仅上任 3 个月，本人否认因违规被解雇
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 4 日消息，微软 Xbox 首位首席运营官 Helen Chiang 确认已离职，她担任该职务仅三个月。Helen Chiang 在微软工作了大约 21 年，从 2005 年入职，2007 年转到 Xbox，微软游戏部门 CEO Asha Sharma 称赞她帮助打造了 Xbox Live。Helen Chiang 后来领导了 Mojang，并于 2020 年成为《我的世界》系列的企业副总裁。Asha Sharma 于今年 7 月设立了 Xbox 首席运营官职位，该职位负责内容、硬件、平台和服务的端到端盈亏等。IT之家注意到，对于网传的“违反政策被解雇”说法，Helen Chiang 本人在 11 月 3 日的 LinkedIn 帖子中进行了否认，表示说法并不准确，她没有向媒体泄露公司机密信息，也从未与任何记者进行过公司授权之外的采访交流。Helen Chiang 也表示，自己离开 Xbox 不是为了加入竞争对手公司，也没有参与歧视、欺凌、骚扰、内幕交易、挪用公款或其他欺诈行为。

articles.title: 国内首款：网易《燕云十六声》官宣 11 月 24 日实装英伟达 DLSS 5
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 4 日消息，网易旗下开放世界武侠游戏《燕云十六声》官方宣布将于 2026 年 11 月 24 日正式实装英伟达 DLSS 5 技术，成为全球首批、国内首款支持该技术的游戏（北美地区将提前一天，于 11 月 23 日先行上线）。DLSS 5 是英伟达在 2026 年 3 月 GTC 大会上公布的新一代实时神经渲染技术，官方将其定位为“图形领域的 GPT 时刻”。与单纯提升分辨率的传统超采样不同，DLSS 5 以游戏每帧的颜色和动态向量为输入，利用 AI 模型为场景生成与原始 3D 内容紧密对齐的拟真光照和材质，最高可在 4K 分辨率下实时运行。据介绍，《燕云十六声》此次接入的是 DLSS 5 中的 3D 引导神经渲染方案。该方案以游戏引擎渲染的帧为不可更改的基础，在完整保留美术人员设计的几何结构、纹理和光照缓冲的前提下，由神经网络实时重建复杂光照与材质细节，目标是提升光照与角色质感，同时避免模糊或清晰度损失。《燕云十六声》官方表示，11 月 24 日上线的版本历经英伟达多轮专项调优，在画面效果与运行帧率之间实现了更好的平衡。官方称后续将继续与英伟达保持技术合作，持续更新迭代渲染效果。需要指出的是，DLSS 5 目前仅对 RTX 50 系列显卡生效，不过英伟达此前已经承诺引入 RTX 40 系列显卡。敬请期待。

articles.content: IT之家 11 月 4 日消息，近日有多个用户反馈，微信正在灰度测试“声音清晰度增强”功能，例如 iOS 客户端在“我-设置-更多”中新增独立入口，用户开启后可在听语音消息、音视频通话等场景获得更清晰的声音。腾讯客服回应IT之家表示，这是微信为提升语音沟通体验推出的智能功能。当用户听不清对方说话时，系统会根据听力情况自动匹配合适的清晰度。有测试权限的用户可以通过“我-设置-更多-声音清晰度增强-开始”找到对应入口。不过，该入口目前仅支持 iOS 和 Android 客户端灰度测试，鸿蒙客户端仍在开发中。值得一提的是，该功能原本位于关怀模式中，只有开启关怀模式才能使用。现在微信为其设置专门入口，即使未开启关怀模式，也可单独开启。在开启这一功能之前，用户还需进行声音听清测试。用户需要听几段音频，并选择是否可以全部听清，系统会据此匹配合适的声音清晰度，用户确认后即可使用。

To preserve the simple structure of FTPL, we develop a novel graph-based loss estimator that combines forced exploration, conditional geometric resampling and adaptive learning rates with surrogate probabilities. Our policy achieves $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(δ_*^{1/3} T^{2/3})$ regret for adversarial regimes as well as $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(δ_* \log T / Δ_{\min}^2)$ regret for stochastic regimes, where $δ_*$ and $Δ$, respectively, denote the fractional weak domination number and the suboptimality gap. These results show that refined guarantees for problems with minimax regret of $Θ(T^{2/3})$ can be obtained through appropriately designed adaptive learning rates and loss estimators without sacrificing the simplicity of FTPL.

articles.title: Weather Adaptive Autonomous Driving
articles.content: Camera object detectors lose recall in rain, fog, snow and sand, and the confidence threshold at which a detector is deployed decides how many objects it misses and how many false alarms it raises. We study how a frozen detector should make this decision in adverse weather. We first reproduce SeqCRC, a conformal object detector whose first step calibrates the confidence threshold by conformal risk control (CRC), and use that step, calibrated separately in each weather condition, as our baseline. With YOLOv8x it keeps the held-out miss fraction within a 20% budget in every DAWN weather bin, where a single global threshold fails in fog, but the false alarms it needs are an output rather than a choice: from 1.6 to 117 per image across DAWN and BDD100K conditions. We then propose a calibrated trade-off dial. One setting, $λ$, the number of false alarms accepted to avoid one missed object, selects the expected-cost-optimal decision rule: either one score threshold, or a per-detection rule that keeps a box when its calibrated probability of being a real object, estimated by gradient-boosted trees from the detector's own per-box outputs, is at least $1/(1+λ)$. F-score preferences map onto the same dial, and CRC applied to $λ$ itself is planned to restore a per-condition miss guarantee. The dial is fitted once on BDD100K train and graded only on BDD100K val and DAWN.

articles.title: FlowTranslator: Training-Free In-Image Machine Translation with Flow-Based Editing
articles.content: In-image machine translation (IIMT) replaces text in an image with its translation while preserving the surrounding visual context. Existing task-specific models achieve convincing performance but require massive paired training images before and after translation. As advanced text-to-image (T2I) models have reached a practically usable level of multilingual text generation, we argue that this capability can be transferred to IIMT and present FlowTranslator. It is a training-free IIMT framework that first employs an OCR model and an LLM to generate the translation prompt, which is injected into the T2I-based diffusion model. To optimize the accurate and natural generation of translated text, we introduce two trajectory controls: Region Coupling Release (RCR) partially decorrelates target-branch noise inside the text region early in the trajectory, while Coupling Expansion (CE) amplifies the emerging edit displacement mid-trajectory. Under the EasyOCR read-back protocol, FlowTranslator achieves average PRIM BLEU and COMET scores of 20.6 and 57.2, respectively, substantially outperforming the strong training-based baseline UniTranslator. On the more challenging and realistic whole-image ScenePair photographs translated into Chinese, it reaches 40.1\% exact-match accuracy and surpasses existing editing systems, some of which only address the text-rendering stage rather than the complete IIMT task. These results establish flow-based editing as a strong, fully training-free baseline for IIMT.

articles.title: OSGR: Observation-Support Graph Reasoning for Earth Observation Question Answering
articles.content: Answering geographic queries over Earth observation (EO) archives requires solving a joint retrieval-and-derivation problem under strict spatiotemporal constraints. Existing LLM agents fail to ground observation items or suffer from search-space explosion. We propose OSGR, a two-stage framework that factorizes this search into offline symbolic concept deduction and online Relation-Conditioned Grounding. OSGR leverages an offline Observation-Support Graph to deduce valid target-to-result support paths at the concept level, and applies spatiotemporal compatibility kernels to instantiate grounded observation-item sets. On Earth-Bench and DisasterM3-Reason, OSGR improves GPT-4o accuracy from 49.3\% to 63.7\% while reducing the execution-step ratio from 2.9 to 2.5.

articles.title: CLOCs-R: Radar-Assisted Camera-LiDAR Fusion for Long-Range Object Detection
articles.content: Long-range 3D object detection remains difficult for autonomous vehicles because LiDAR returns become sparse and camera evidence weakens with distance, while automotive radar keeps returning measurements far beyond both. We present CLOCs-R, an extension of the CLOCs candidate-level fusion framework that adds radar evidence to camera-LiDAR rescoring. Radar returns are accumulated over several sweeps, compensated for ego-motion, and associated with each pre-NMS 3D candidate through a range-dependent gate. Compact features summarizing support, Doppler speed and spread, range residual, and offset are then appended to every camera-LiDAR pair before a lightweight fusion network rescores the candidates. We first verify that our fusion implementation reproduces CLOCs on KITTI. We then evaluate on the daytime clear-weather subset of the aiMotive dataset, reporting distance-binned metrics out to 200 m with frozen SECOND and Cascade R-CNN detectors. Camera-LiDAR CLOCs improves on SECOND up to 50 m but degrades beyond it. A residual scoring variant, introduced post hoc, corrects SECOND's score instead of replacing it and recovers most of this loss. Radar consistently improves BEV AP at 30-50 m (0.857 to 0.870), but beyond 50 m its gain is small (+0.003 center-distance AP), within seed variation, and CLOCs-R with residual scoring is statistically tied with LiDAR-only SECOND. Our analysis attributes the limited long-range benefit to weak separation of true and false detections by radar features, scarce far-range training positives, poor camera evidence at distance, and missing LiDAR proposals that rescoring cannot recover. We report all as-designed and post hoc results side by side.

articles.title: SEAM: Situated Executable Associative Memory for a Co-located Community
articles.content: In groups, knowledge is distributed among individuals, and how it is brought together depends on social ties. Taking inspiration from how a single mind recalls and reacts to memories and current stimulus, we build a shared memory that does this for a community, prototyped as a social app, SEAM. Members post arbitrary moments; SEAM works out how fragments relate, distills knowledge about the group, and replies in a situated and associative way. Some of these memories act as instructions that can alter how the system behaves, making it programmable by its members. We deployed SEAM to 46 people in a co-located community for two weeks of open-ended use, and ran a follow-up workshop with 14. Members shared their days, interrogated the memory, and instructed it to track routines and run games; replies introduced them to people and subjects they had never encountered. SEAM points towards communities where knowledge finds people.

articles.title: Reciprocity Can Erase Direction:tructural Boundaries and Controlled Utility of Magnetic Graph Networks
articles.content: Magnetic graph networks encode direction through phase, but a learned graph can erase the intended directional mechanism before prediction. We characterize this failure for support-based magnetic Laplacians. Exact identities relate imaginary energy and distance from zero phase to amplitude-weighted reciprocity. Top-$k$ selection forces complete collapse when the observed-node count satisfies $m\leq k+1$, and dense support imposes a lower bound on reciprocal-arc fraction. We then construct paired propagation examples with identical node features and symmetric amplitudes but opposite labels, giving a provable chance-level limit for direction-erasing representations. In 72 fixed neural fits, support phase achieved test AUROC 1.0000 on a unilateral ring but 0.5000 on reciprocal ring and complete supports; continuous score phase and a real directed comparator achieved 1.0000 throughout. All models solved the direction-free control. These are oracle-direction mechanism tests, not evidence of learned clinical direction. In the preserved public DeepDRiD development study, continuous phase was active but its robustness difference from zero phase was only $+0.0036$ (descriptive 95\% interval $-0.0014$ to $+0.0095$) on validation patients used for checkpoint selection. The contribution is a structural and experimental framework for distinguishing erased direction from unestablished task utility. It provides a precise circumstance in which magnetic phase preserves useful information, without asserting universal or clinical superiority.

articles.title: How Risky Is Your Data-Driven Policy?
articles.content: Data-driven algorithms are ubiquitous across industries, and there is an extensive literature on analyzing their \emph{average} performance. The risk profile of such algorithms, while critical, is much less understood. This paper quantifies the risk of data-driven policies and isolates its sources. We evaluate a policy through the conditional value-at-risk (CVaR) of its loss over the training sample, any policy randomization, and the future outcome, at a fixed unknown distribution. Regret against an oracle that knows the distribution decomposes into expected post-sample regret (PS), the average outcome-only CVaR gap of the selected action, and a sample-risk premium (SR), the additional tail risk omitted by averaging those evaluations. The analogous premium vanishes under expected loss.   We characterize when the premium vanishes and how large it is relative to post-sample regret. For losses with a continuous density near the tail cutoff, we identify conditions under which both components decay at the same rate, yet the limiting ratio of the premium to post-sample regret can reach the thousands. When a probability mass at the cutoff moves with the action, the premium can decay more slowly and dominate post-sample regret. We establish conditions under which sample average approximation learns the oracle action at rate $n^{-1/2}$ in both settings, but its combined-risk regret is of order $n^{-1}$ in the first and $n^{-1/2}$ in the second. In finite-sample numerical examples of SAA in both settings, the premium accounts for approximately $74\%$--$97\%$ of regret.

articles.title: When Debate Amplifies Risk: Social-Bias Vulnerabilities in Multi-Agent Safety Deliberation
articles.content: Retrieval-augmented Web applications increasingly employ multi-agent debate (MAD) to aggregate conflicting, noisy, and heterogeneous information, yet deliberation is fundamentally a social process susceptible to interpersonal dynamics. When retrieved Web sources contain latent hazards alongside safe factual content, social biases such as conformity pressure and authority deference can override evidence-grounded safety boundaries. In this work, we investigate whether the social structure of deliberation can paradoxically amplify latent Web safety risks. We introduce SafeConflict-Bias, a controlled counterfactual diagnostic protocol spanning six core Web risk categories, which holds queries and retrieved evidence strictly invariant while isolating conversational majority sway, authority cues, and confidence asymmetry. Empirical evaluation across diverse proprietary and open-source backbones reveals that while isolated models reliably reject unsafe guidance, standard MAD catastrophically capitulates to social pressure---surging unsafe adoption from 0.0\% up to 100.0\% and systematically silencing safe minority evidence. To resolve this systemic fragility without retraining or debate regeneration, we propose RiskTrace-Debias, an inference-time auditing framework uniting evidence-first precommitment, social-metadata masking, and consistency-gated arbitration. RiskTrace-Debias suppresses worst-case unsafe adoption to $\le 2.0\%$ across all architectures without inducing over-refusal, while generating verifiable provenance traces to audit interpersonal manipulation in Web deliberation.

articles.title: Predicting protein structures at any folding stage from sequence
articles.content: Protein structure predictors reliably identify native conformations, but do not describe the continuum connecting unfolded ensembles to folded states. Here we present FoldScape, a sequence-conditioned deep learning framework that generates C$α$ conformational ensembles at a specified folding fraction $Q$. FoldScape reconstructs three-dimensional chains through hierarchical, sliding-window regressions of one-dimensional inter-residue distances, followed by chain assembly and sampling with a rectified-flow decoder. It is trained on multi-scale coarse-grained folding trajectories and all-atom mechanical-unfolding trajectories. Across 20 human proteins (36-857 residues), at matched sample size, FoldScape covers about an order of magnitude more of the folding coordinate than seed-varied AlphaFold 3 ensembles, robustly across proteins, order parameters and binning choices. AlphaFold 3 better anchors the immediate native vicinity, which FoldScape does not reach, making the approaches complementary. FoldScape reconstruction accuracy remains approximately constant along $Q$, from collapsed coil to near-native globule, rather than deteriorating away from the native state. A stride-one crop-and-superpose scheme extends inference to chains several times longer than a single chain-level forward pass. We also show that training trajectories resolve mechanical unfolding at residue resolution, that elongation-conditioned ensembles exhibit reproducible continuous observables across pulling velocities, and that partially unfolded chains form geometrically coherent segments. FoldScape thus combines broad coverage of folding stages with stable reconstruction accuracy, without per-protein simulation.

articles.title: GroundSeek-CXR: Retrospective Evaluation-Guided Active Observation Framework for Multi-Label Chest Radiography Diagnosis
articles.content: Chest radiography (CXR) diagnosis is critical for thoracic disease assessment, yet challenged by the need to identify subtle lesions and co-occurring abnormalities across regions. While recent vision-language models can actively observe local regions, existing preference-based methods supervise each observation by its immediate effect on the current diagnosis, failing to capture how each observation and stopping decision contributes to the final diagnosis. To address this issue, we propose GroundSeek-CXR, an active CXR diagnosis framework that learns observation and stopping decisions by retrospectively evaluating them with the final diagnosis. Specifically, we first devise a Retrospective Diagnostic Evaluation (RDE) that scores observation and stop candidates from offline Monte Carlo tree search through independent continuations. Moreover, we design a Retrospective Gap-weighted Preference Optimization (RGPO) that learns from retrospective-score preferences weighted by their score gaps, prioritizing actions that improve diagnostic accuracy. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our GroundSeek-CXR framework outperforms state-of-the-art methods, and improves abnormal-image sample-F1 by 4.48% over immediate-score preference learning.

articles.title: Bidirectional Centered Score Matching for Discrete Diffusion Distillation
articles.content: Discrete diffusion models with parallel decoding are often distilled using token-wise KL objectives. Although token-wise KL exactly matches the corresponding product-form block distributions, its probability-space optimization geometry and teacher-only candidate truncation may provide insufficient supervision under aggressive few-step distillation. Concrete Score Matching (CSM) provides an alternative within-position objective by aligning relative logit geometry, but its complete pairwise form incurs $\mathcal{O}(|\mathcal{V}|^2)$ complexity. We propose Bidirectional Centered Score Matching (BCSM), an efficient within-position distillation objective that constructs an $\mathcal{O}(K)$ bidirectional active set, reduces pairwise comparisons to $\mathcal{O}(K^2)$, and factorizes them into an $\mathcal{O}(K)$ objective. We further introduce cross-timestep transition alignment. Experiments demonstrate strong quality--efficiency trade-offs, including up to $6\times$ NFE reduction with a 16.9\% relative HumanEval gain and a 15.1\% relative MMMU gain at single-step inference.

articles.title: Harness-S: Learning from Sibling Harnesses for Generalizable Agent Training
articles.content: Harness evolution from a common base exhibits Locality, Complementarity, and Nonstationarity: variants repair different failures, and their utility changes as the policy learns. Rather than seeking a universally superior harness, we introduce Harness-S to selectively rescue failures of a base execution system through sibling harnesses and transfer the resulting capabilities into a single policy that remains effective under the original harness. Directional Harness Evolution develops specialized sibling harnesses along distinct repair directions, forming a reusable Sibling Harness Pool that remains fixed during policy training. Complementary Harness Rescue Training invokes this pool only when all initial attempts under the base harness fail. The same policy generates fresh rollouts under selected auxiliary harnesses, and these trajectories replace the failed group for reinforcement learning. An Adaptive Harness Router selects the Top-k variants using Harness Behavior Profiles and voting across multiple LLMs. Policy-aware profile re-anchoring refreshes this evidence as the policy learns. Across AppWorld, SWE-Gym, and DBBench, the trained policy substantially outperforms policy-only training when returned to the original base harness. Behavioral analyses and held-out cases support the transfer of harness-elicited behaviors into the policy itself. Reusing the router for Rank-1 inference provides additional gains at the same executor rollout count.

articles.title: Deep Learning Compilers: Architecture, Optimization, and Empirical Characterization
articles.content: As deep learning (DL) models become increasingly complex and hardware architectures grow more heterogeneous, DL compilers play a critical role in optimizing computational efficiency and enabling scalable deployment. This paper presents a systematic analysis of DL compilers, covering their architectural evolution, compilation workflows, optimization techniques, and emerging research directions. We organize DL compiler architectures into frontend, middle-end, and backend stages, emphasizing the role of the middle-end in connecting high-level model representations with hardware-specific optimizations. We further examine representative DL compilers and recent optimization techniques across different compilation stages. Beyond architectural and technical analysis, we conduct an empirical evaluation of compiler behaviors to investigate the effectiveness of graph optimization, compilation overhead, and dynamic-shape handling. Experiments using PyTorch/TorchInductor on an NVIDIA RTX A6000 demonstrate that compiler benefits depend strongly on workload characteristics, with speedups of up to 8.21\times for fusion-friendly computation graphs, while other workloads exhibit limited improvements. Our results further reveal that compilation overhead can require thousands of executions to amortize, and dynamic-shape compilation reduces cumulative shape-transition costs by approximately 70\% at the expense of modest steady-state performance degradation. By combining systematic architectural analysis with quantitative experimental evidence, this work provides insights into the design, optimization, and practical deployment of modern DL compilers.

articles.title: Integrating Machine Learning and Uncertainty Quantification for Real-Time Decision-Making in Digital Twins: A System-Centric Review and Perspective
articles.content: Digital Twins are evolving from passive virtual representations into closed-loop systems that continuously synchronize with physical assets and drive real-time decisions. Yet predictive modeling, machine learning (ML), uncertainty quantification (UQ), and decision-making have been studied as separate capabilities, leaving limited understanding of their integration and maintenance during online operation. This narrative review, scoped by the functional requirements of real-time decision-making rather than by Digital Twin terminology alone, examines how such decisions are generated and sustained in engineering Digital Twins. We first examine foundational decision-making architectures and representative engineering applications, followed by methods that address their limitations across the decision loop. We identify optimization-based, policy-based, and knowledge-based approaches as the major pathways from virtual representation to action. Across them, ML plays three roles in decision-making: enabling efficient surrogate modeling, transforming heterogeneous physical feedback into decision-relevant information, and accelerating or directly generating decisions. UQ supports uncertainty-aware decisions and model adaptation, while continual validation, drift detection, and adaptation help maintain reliable operation as the physical system evolves. Together, these findings underscore the need for a shift from a model-centric to a system-centric perspective on Digital Twins, where its performance depends on the interactions with sensing, state estimation, computation, decision-making, and adaptation rather than on their standalone performance. Therefore, future research should shift from isolated algorithm development toward system-level co-design, scalable decision-making, and approaches to design, and data-efficient continual adaptation and validation for AI-enabled autonomous systems.

articles.title: Weight-Space Programming for Improving Image-Restoration Diffusion Models: Technical Conjectures and a Recursive Improvement Loop
articles.content: Can an LLM directly edit the weights of a diffusion-based image-restoration model to \emph{improve} restoration quality---without gradients, paired data, or fine-tuning? Recent experiments show frontier LLMs can fix structural bugs by modifying as little as \(0.016\%\) of parameters, but cannot instill new capabilities. We ask whether weight-space programming (WSP) can move from \emph{debugging} to \emph{improvement} in the precise-regression setting of image restoration (deblurring, super-resolution, denoising, inpainting). Restoration diffusion UNets present a middle ground: low-level signal-processing layers are concentrated enough for targeted weight-direction edits, while high-level semantic layers remain distributed and resistant to sparse modification. We propose three technical conjectures: (C1) an LLM can localize the layer behind a quality gap (over-smoothing, color shift, hallucinated texture) within a 200 forward-pass budget; (C2) editing a small set of identified weight directions (e.g., scaling high-frequency filter norms, correcting output-bias channels) can measurably improve PSNR and perceptual quality; (C3) a recursive loop---diagnose \(\rightarrow\) edit \(\rightarrow\) evaluate \(\rightarrow\) re-diagnose---can compound gains across rounds, forming a minimal recursive self-improvement (RSI) loop for vision. We analyze the required AI capability (arguing targeted edits need not superintelligence, while general capability generation does) and detail the challenges of precise pixel-level regression. We provide a PyTorch-style deployment pipeline and outline a benchmark. This manuscript is conjectural, intended to open a new subtopic for image restoration.

articles.title: Reliability Stress Testing of RAG Retrieval under Query-Relevant Corpus Poisoning
articles.content: External text can affect a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system only after the retriever admits it to the model context. We stress this admission step while varying document content, attacker query information, per-target poison budget, and contamination scope. Across 623 Benchmarking Information Retrieval (BEIR) queries from SciFact and NFCorpus, five query-targeted documents per query reduce classical-retriever nDCG@10 by 40.2-61.5% in isolated-target stress. Full-query anchoring explains most Best Matching 25 (BM25) degradation, whereas appended text also shifts latent semantic analysis (LSA) and Hybrid rankings. A pretrained BGE-small validation reaches 100% target exposure for query-only P=5 on both datasets; adding the injection payload changes SciFact nDCG only from 0.269 to 0.271 and lowers NFCorpus exposure slightly to 98.8%, indicating that query anchoring remains the dominant retrieval-side factor for this dense model. Query length materially changes the interpretation of partial-information attacks: on 162 long SciFact queries, two random terms cover 19.9% of eligible terms and still yield 39.5% Hybrid target exposure. Multi-target contamination adds cross-target interference. Overlap-based admission can remove full-query poisons but may sharply reduce clean retrieval utility, and maximal marginal relevance (MMR) leaves exposure unchanged under the tested configuration. The study measures retrieval-layer failures, not downstream instruction following.

articles.title: Sketch-Omni: Instance-Level Sketch-Based Visual Prompting for Perception MLLMs
articles.content: Promptable perception, from GroundingDINO to Rex-Omni, puts one model behind one prompt interface and returns coordinates for any localisation task. Every model in that line was built for photographs; none has been given a sketch. We present Sketch-Omni, to our knowledge the first perception MLLM built to work on sketches and from them. On a sketch, the sketch is the image, and text prompts detect, point, resolve object and spatial referring expressions, and ground affordances in it. From a sketch, the sketch is the prompt, and a drawing of one object localises that object in a photograph, even among several of the same category, a query that neither a category name nor a photo exemplar can pose. Two obstacles stand in the way. A photo-trained model's attention is tuned to colour and texture, which a sketch does not have, and no dataset pairs a drawing with the one instance it depicts among others of its kind. We build the training data instead of collecting it. An edge detector turns every labelled photograph into a sketch-like drawing that keeps the photograph's labels, and two constructions produce sketch-to-photo instance pairs from existing data. On top of this, photo-guided relation alignment passes each photograph and its edge sketch through the same model and trains the sketch pass to reproduce how the photograph pass relates phrases to patches and patches to each other. Not one training label is drawn by hand. Sketch-Omni reaches 91.4 F1 on sketch-prompted localisation against 81.8 for the strongest general-purpose MLLM, with a lead that doubles when the photograph holds several instances of the queried category, and it is best in 39 of 40 evaluation cells across six tasks. Code, model, and a hand-annotated benchmark of 2754 sketch-to-photo links will be released.

articles.title: Neologism Inoculation Prompting
articles.content: Inoculation prompting is a method to reduce undesired behaviours such as reward hacking in frontier models. It works by training a model on harmful examples under a prompt that specifies the undesired behaviour, which reduces the model's tendency to exhibit it unless prompted. However, the inoculation prompt is written in plain English, so any user can re-elicit the behaviour easily. We introduce neologism inoculation prompting (NIP), which replaces the English prompt with a new token that is trained on the frozen model and removed at deployment. NIP outperforms other inoculation methods, and performs competitively with gradient routing despite being simpler. It also works on reward hacking, but fails on sycophancy and harassment. Using control tokens and analyses of activations, we identify the mechanism for this as NIP hiding the harmful behaviour behind an unreachable region of model inputs, rather than deleting it. More broadly, our work suggests that neologisms can be a powerful way to carve out and shape access to behaviours that are undesired or harmful.

articles.title: ProGeo-RC: Prototype-guided Semantic Reliability and Geometric Error Calibration for Semi-supervised Cardiac Image Segmentation
articles.content: Semi-supervised medical image segmentation aims to train reliable segmentation models using limited labeled data and abundant unlabeled data. However, existing methods typically rely on prediction confidence or model consistency to estimate pseudo-label reliability, but these criteria are insufficient to characterize both semantic reliability and geometric plausibility. To address this issue, we propose ProGeo-RC, a prototype-guided semantic reliability and geometric error calibration framework for semi-supervised medical image segmentation. ProGeo-RC consists of two key modules: Prototype-guided Semantic Reliability Estimation (PSRE) and Structured Semantic-Geometric Error Calibration (S-SGEC). PSRE uses probabilistic class prototypes to estimate the semantic reliability of unlabeled predictions and calibrate pixel-wise teacher pseudo labels, while S-SGEC introduces signed-distance-field-based geometric constraints to refine ambiguous boundaries and suppress spurious foreground responses outside target structures. Experiments on the ACDC and MVAA-CT datasets show that ProGeo-RC achieves better performance compared with representative semi-supervised segmentation methods. Under the 10\% labeled setting on ACDC, ProGeo-RC improves DSC and Jaccard by 0.37\% and 0.49\% over the corresponding second-best results, while reducing 95HD and ASD by 0.61 and 0.21, respectively. These results indicate that joint semantic reliability estimation and geometric error calibration can provide more reliable pseudo supervision for semi-supervised medical image segmentation.

articles.title: OmniST: Topology-Invariant Spatiotemporal Forecasting with Guaranteed-Coverage Uncertainty at Unseen Sensor Locations
articles.content: Standard spatiotemporal graph convolutional networks need a fixed-size adjacency matrix, coupling model weights to a specific sensor count N; they cannot produce any output at a sensor absent from training. We present OmniST, a topology-invariant forecaster whose computation has zero structural dependency on the number of nodes, and which, composed with inductive split-conformal calibration, gives distribution-free, coverage-guaranteed prediction intervals at arbitrary (including never-seen) sensor locations, preserving that guarantee as sensors are added or removed. Topology invariance follows from coordinate-based tokenization, k-nearest-neighbor attention from geographic coordinates at each forward pass, and per-node temporal processing via a bidirectional GRU. On real Delhi air-quality data (37 stations, 2019-2023), OmniST attains a 30-day PM2.5 MAE of 31.0 ug/m3 and degrades at most 1.1 percent when 40 percent of stations are removed. Its inductive forecasts at unseen stations beat nearest-neighbor interpolation (about 12 percent) and a learned kriging GNN (IGNNK, about 21 percent), and, unlike either, carry a finite-sample coverage guarantee. The guarantee holds at 90 percent or above under 30-50 percent node dropout across four real datasets over three domains (Delhi and Beijing air quality, NOAA GHCN weather, Caltrans PeMSD7-M traffic), and still holds at 325 real sensors (full PeMS-BAY). We also fix a temporal-drift failure: static conformal under-covers over time (about 0.50 late), but a rolling adaptive-conformal estimator restores target coverage (0.89 overall, 0.96 late) at the cost of wider intervals.

articles.title: ActOR: Ambient AI-Based Agentic Orchestration for Humanoid Autonomy in Operating Rooms
articles.content: Operating rooms (ORs) increasingly contain ambient sensing infrastructure to enable AI-based optimization of workflows and utilization. We pursue an alternative path: using ambient AI to guide robot action and optimize utilization. Deploying humanoids in the OR without ambient AI is severely limited by cumbersome de novo orientation and planning due to partial onboard observations. We posit that this can be achieved by coupling an ambient AI-based agentic orchestrator with the humanoid robotic actor, providing shared perception and execution feedback for humanoid autonomy in the OR. ActOR fuses a wall-mounted ambient camera and the robot's head-mounted camera into a shared object-level digital twin (DT). A large language model agent plans over the DT using pre-programmed locomotion and manipulation skills without task-specific training. During execution, DT updates and execution outcomes inform retries, alternative approaches, or replanning. We evaluated ActOR in simulated and physical environments. Across three tasks in two simulated ORs reconstructed from real rooms, ambient perception reduced exploration from 1.05 to 0.12 Explore calls per trial when targets were initially outside the robot's view. Closed-loop feedback increased success from 46.7% to 83.3% under nominal execution and from 8.3% to 51.7% under injected navigation, object-relocation, and grasp perturbations. In a physical mock OR with a humanoid, ActOR completed 14 of 20 single-object disposal trials and demonstrated replanning after scene changes. Ambient AI-based observations provide scene state that improves robot action planning, increasing success and reducing exploration compared with robot-only observations. Feeding skill outcomes and DT updates back to the planner improves multi-step task success. Our results show the feasibility of humanoid task autonomy for multi-step disposal tasks in a mock OR.

articles.title: P-SER: Physical Consistency-Constrained Scattering Expandable Representation for Class-Incremental HRRP Target Recognition
articles.content: High-resolution range profiles (HRRPs) provide compact radar target representations but exhibit strong aspect sensitivity, complicating class-incremental recognition when historical data are unavailable. Changes in viewing aspect shift scattering-peak locations and amplitudes, while reflector groups may produce responses resembling ships. Existing dynamic expansion methods can also incur substantial parameter and memory overhead. To address these challenges, we propose P-SER, a Physical Consistency-Constrained Scattering Expandable Representation framework for exemplar-free class-incremental HRRP recognition. P-SER reconstructs dominant scattering points from complex-valued sum- and azimuth-difference-channel HRRPs and observation geometry. The reconstructed spatial structure, target extent, and energy distribution are used to derive class-level scattering prototypes and sample-level saliency priors, providing physically grounded constraints for feature learning and old-class knowledge retention. A primitive scatterer dictionary further characterizes local strong-scattering mechanisms and calibrates uncertain ship--reflector predictions at inference. Meanwhile, lightweight residual adapters are incrementally introduced into a shared HRRP backbone to learn new classes with limited model growth. Experiments on simulated and measured HRRP datasets show that P-SER delivers competitive recognition performance without retaining old-class exemplars, while maintaining physical consistency, interference robustness, knowledge retention, and model scalability.

articles.title: COMPREHEND: Ultra-Fine-Grained Benchmark Understanding by Entailment Hierarchy
articles.content: Understanding what kind of prompts users typically ask and how well an LLM performs on these prompt categories is crucial for LLM practitioners. The existing methods satisfy the demand by hierarchically clustering the user prompts and synthesizing the cluster names using an LLM to build a taxonomy. However, the cluster names from these methods are usually too general for humans to understand the detailed prompt distributions and identify the exact strengths and weaknesses of LLMs. In this study, we propose COMPREHEND, which automatically constructs an ultra-fine-grained entailment hierarchy for the prompts. The entailment hierarchy replaces the cluster names in the taxonomy with sentences to provide more precise cluster descriptions for more fine-grained categorization. Compared with EvalTree, a state-of-the-art taxonomy construction method, COMPREHEND improves an entailment/faithfulness metric from 22.6 to 41.7 and an informative metric from 16.3 to 39.1 in WildBench. Our experiments also show that the weakness report generated based on our entailment hierarchy is much more informative than EvalTree in terms of predicting the response scores in the benchmark. All the code is released in https://github.com/JackNapier20/COMPREHEND_public.

articles.title: Navigating Runtime Dynamism in Semantic Query Serving
articles.content: LLM-powered semantic queries increasingly combine relational processing with multiple LLM-based operators over unstructured data. Efficiently serving such queries is challenging due to runtime dynamism at two coupled levels. Across queries, dynamic arrivals and heterogeneous resource demands continuously change scheduling priorities. Within a query, heterogeneous characteristics across fine-grained input batches cause operator costs and selectivities to vary throughout execution, making a statically optimized plan unreliable. These two forms of dynamism create a circular dependency: inter-query scheduling requires estimates of remaining LLM work, while the remaining work depends on runtime plan choices whose costs become observable only during execution.   We present SeqoFlow, a runtime framework that jointly adapts query plans and schedules concurrent semantic queries. SeqoFlow enumerates equivalence-preserving plan alternatives under operator dependencies and decomposes queries into fine-grained units, enabling safe plan adaptation and query preemption at batch boundaries. To support both decisions without exhaustively profiling candidate plans on the target LLM, SeqoFlow uses lightweight speculative estimation to capture runtime costs. These estimates jointly guide plan adaptation and inter-query scheduling, closing the loop between query optimization and LLM inference. Experiments across diverse query structures, data distributions, and arrival rates show that SeqoFlow substantially reduces end-to-end latency compared to existing semantic query systems, adaptive query processing techniques, and conventional scheduling policies.

articles.title: CounterSketch: Physics-Grounded Counterfactual Reasoning for Sketch-to-Video Generation
articles.content: Counterfactual sketch animation explores how a static sketch evolves under a hypothetical intervention. We present CounterSketch, a physics-grounded framework that transforms natural-language ``What if...?'' queries into physically plausible sketch animations. The framework integrates VLM-guided scene grounding, causal event-chain reasoning, constraint-based trajectory generation, and verification. It models physical transitions to update the scene graph, computes continuous object trajectories, and validates them against physical, geometric, and semantic constraints. The verified trajectories are then projected into object-level motion bounding boxes to guide downstream sketch-video synthesis. Experiments on CounterSketchBench (80 questions) demonstrate that physics-grounded trajectories provide stronger motion guidance than direct VLM predictions.

articles.title: Improving Diffusion-Based Augmentation for Data-Scarce Image Classification via Mask-Guided Reference Attention and Repulsive Noise Optimization
articles.content: Diffusion-based data augmentation has emerged as a powerful strategy for addressing data-scarce image classification. Recent pipelines typically adapt a pretrained text-to-image diffusion model to a limited number of class examples and subsequently sample synthetic images using diverse textual prompts. However, in extreme data-scarce regimes such as long-tailed single-sample settings, this approach suffers from a dual failure mode: the generated samples often lack discriminative foreground details crucial for classifier training, and the adapted class prior can bias the early denoising process, causing output images to exhibit similar patterns despite varying text prompts. To overcome these limitations, we propose a sampling-side framework of two complementary components that simultaneously enhance fine details and diversity. First, Mask-Guided Reference (MGR) Attention updates only foreground value tokens with reference features via zero-shot segmentation, limiting reference influence to the target object and mitigating excessive global feature injection. Second, Repulsive Noise Optimization (RNO) encourages initial noise trajectories to diverge from dominant generative modes of the adapted model, enabling target prompts to express broader contextual variation. Extensive evaluations show consistent improvements, with the largest gains in long-tailed single-sample settings of up to 2.50 and 2.94 points on CUB-LT IF100, and further robustness across few-shot and background-shift evaluations.

articles.title: AceAction-5M: Hierarchical Goals for Generalist Action Learning Across 3D Game Worlds
articles.content: Video games provide a practical setting for collecting vision-language-action (VLA) data, whose acquisition in physical environments is costly. Existing datasets, however, remain limited by restricted game coverage, sparse language supervision, or temporal hierarchies that do not necessarily reflect changes in task objectives. We introduce AceAction, a dataset of human gameplay across multiple 3D games for learning skill composition and subgoal transitions. AceAction organizes demonstrations around complete tasks, linking overall instructions, ordered subgoals, and local skill instructions to temporally aligned visual observations and keyboard-and-mouse actions. To construct these annotations, we develop a vision-language model pipeline that identifies subgoals from changes in objectives or interaction targets, anchors navigation goals to visually recognizable waypoints, and composes adjacent subgoals into task instructions. The resulting demonstrations cover navigation, reconnaissance, combat, interaction, and recovery, with explicit stage boundaries that connect task progression to fine-grained control. We assess annotation quality through model-based verification and human inspection. An audit of 500 trajectories yields a 95.8% pass rate across independent reviewer assessments. AceAction provides a data foundation for studying how agents execute, combine, and switch skills to follow complex instructions in dynamic game environments.

articles.title: LIRA: A More Interpretable Dynamic Loss-Informed Rank Allocation for Low-Rank Adaptation
articles.content: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) has become a widely used parameter-efficient fine-tuning method for large pretrained models. However, standard LoRA typically assigns a fixed rank profile despite layer- and stage-dependent adaptation needs, while recent adaptive-rank variants often rely on heuristic or first-order signals that provide only an indirect link between rank reallocation and local loss behavior. This leaves the rationale behind each rank reallocation insufficiently interpretable. Motivated by this gap, we propose LIRA (Loss-Informed Rank Allocation), a dynamic-rank LoRA method designed to make online rank reallocation more interpretable. LIRA scores each layer by the estimated magnitude of the local loss perturbation associated with its recent LoRA-factor movements under a second-order approximation, making the basis for each rank change interpretable term by term. By periodically applying DELTA (Displacement-Evaluated Loss-Trajectory Allocation), a displacement-based algorithm for LoRA rank reallocation, LIRA produces discrete effective ranks under matched budgets while remaining compatible with standard (A,B) adapters. On RoBERTa-base GLUE under the La-LoRA/LoRA protocol, LIRA outperforms the uniform-LoRA and adaptive-rank baselines reported under this protocol; Trajectory EMA attains performance competitive with Fixed-point Fisher at lower estimation cost.

articles.title: TCINet: Tissue-Conditioned Adaptive Cross-Branch Interaction Network for Nuclei Instance Segmentation
articles.content: Separating touching nuclei requires local boundary detail, while cell type classification requires broader morphological context. These requirements also vary with the surrounding tissue environment. We propose the Tissue-Conditioned Adaptive Cross-Branch Interaction Network (TCINet), a single-stage model with Task-Specific Feature Adapters (TSFA) and Tissue-Conditioned Task-Aware Cross-Branch Interaction (TC-TACBI). TSFA produces branch-specific features at skip connections, and TC-TACBI controls three asymmetric paths among nucleus-presence (NP), horizontal-vertical (HV), and nucleus-type (NT) branches using predicted tissue probabilities. On PanNuke under standard three-fold cross-validation, TCINet achieves multiclass and binary panoptic quality scores of 0.519 and 0.692, respectively. Zero-shot tests on MoNuSeg yield a detection F1 score of 0.876. On PanNuke fold 0, adding TC-TACBI increases mPQ from 0.505 to 0.525. Code is available at https://github.com/celestial1321/TCINet.

articles.title: 90 后北大副教授董豪：启元机器人，正在勇闯具身终局
articles.content: 做具身，不能一上来什么都干，也不能什么都不干。    作者丨齐铖湧    编辑丨岑   峰                                                                                                       董豪是具身行业里一个十足的非典型选手。大多数人对他的印象，停在 29 岁便是北大博导的年轻学者身份，以及最近任职启元机器人首席科学家、带队攻坚家用具身智能的产业标签。但很少有人知道，他读博之前曾有过一段三年创业最终折戟的经历，住过工厂的八人间宿舍；更少有人知道，智元刚创立时，他就是最早加入、陪着初创团队闯过无数关口的核心成员之一。当行业还在热议大模型、通用机器人的宏大叙事时，他盯着的是另一个一点都不性感的真问题：靠上万台真机做后训练，成本高到难以落地，这条路要怎么破？他最近给出的答案是三个关键词：HIL-UMI、Scaling Law 和量产。而这份答案的底层逻辑，早就写进了他一路 “压缩着走” 的人生里。硕士毕业，他婉拒了导师的直接读博的建议，回国创办公司做可穿戴设备与脑机接口，一头扎进工厂，住过八人间宿舍。三年后亲眼见证市场被大厂快速挤压，他没有恋战，转身回到帝国理工攻读博士，四年后顺利毕业，期间主导开发的开源框架，还斩获了 ACM MM 最佳开源软件奖。 毕业后，他加入北京大学入职不久就撞上疫情，对着全程不开摄像头的学生，线上讲了一整年的机器人课。2023 年智元机器人创立，他作为核心成员加入，成立北大智元联合实验室；如今他转身出任启元首席科学家，一头扎进了难度最高的 ToC 具身智能赛道。在行业里，董豪向来朋友众多，创业经历、顶尖学术、头部产业的履历，也带着一种罕见的跨界流动感。一个完整亲历过硬科技公司从起盘到落幕全过程的人，又转身沉潜到学术浓度极高的北京大学，如今再站到产业最前沿，他会怎么看当下的具身智能行业？ 带着这个问题，我们在北大校园里见到了董豪。以下是访谈内容，《AI 科技评论》在不改变原意的基础上做了编辑。01一个"压缩着走"的人▎AI科技评论：你英本英硕四年读完，29岁北大博导。这个节奏在学术圈压缩了三五年。你自己意识到吗？董豪：没刻意算过。英本英硕那个体系本来就快，四年硕士毕业是正常操作。▎AI科技评论：但不到30岁入职北大不正常，你拿到教职第一年还撞上疫情。董豪：第一次上课是线上，学生不开摄像头，不吱声，我全程自己讲，有时候问问有没有问题，没人回。搞机器人的全线上，机器人摸不到。最惨的是突然解封能用一下，突然又封了，断断续续。很多人没熬过去，我运气还不错。▎AI科技评论：只归给运气？董豪：还有就是我做的事聚焦。机器人这个方向，学术和产业都关注，两头都不浪费。▎AI科技评论：“两头都不浪费”，这个说法很像你。你好像天生不喜欢单维度做事。董豪：可能吧。比如你提到我以前做的AI框架，当时本来是实验室内部工具，放着可惜就开源了，结果用户越来越多，还拿了奖。一个工作，长出好几个东西，效率高。02一位90后北大副教授的创业往事▎AI科技评论：2012 年硕士毕业，导师郭毅可（中国工程院外籍院士、现港科大首席副校长）劝你读博，你没听，回国创业，具体是什么情况。董豪：研究生跟着郭老师做科研，郭老师让直接读博，结果我决定回国创业，他支持我，还给了钱，后来 2015 年回去读博，他也没说什么，给了我很大自由，让我自己选课题。▎AI科技评论：创业做可穿戴设备？董豪：是的，当时势头很猛。创业的时候住工厂，条件很差，都是八人间，我待遇好一点，一个人住一个八人间，八个床，想睡哪个睡哪个。▎AI科技评论：那三年应该挺苦的。董豪：苦倒不至于，就是看得见一个创业团队完整的命。可穿戴设备：便携脑机接口、智能手环，我们先做的，前者是面向未来、后者面向当下。小米华为后来入局可穿戴，但人家一做起来非常快。眼睁睁看着市场没了。▎AI科技评论：硬科技创业最难的是什么？董豪：量产。样机半年就能做出来，但你要造一百个产品，成本要控制住，良品率要高，还得耐用，这个要花一两年。一个小改

articles.content: 具身智能的资本筛选标准，正在从"讲得动人"转向"兑现得动"。    作者丨齐铖湧    编辑丨岑   峰                                                                                                       AI 科技评论获悉，11 月 2 日，RoboScience 机器科学完成 A2 轮融资。据悉，本轮由琥珀资本、鸿瑞达投资、上海半导体产投 联合领投，360 战投、爽资本、国联民生资本、金鼎资本及多家上市公司平台跟投，融资金额达到了数亿元。这意味着，这家 2025 年 3 月才正式开始运营的具身公司，先后已完成五轮融资。据 AI 科技评论了解，近期具身行业融资市场并不乐观。过去一年，这个赛道的融资叙事换了好几轮：最早讲世界模型就能拿到钱；后来光讲技术不够了，得讲落地，讲进工厂的 ROI ；再后来，得有"具身 RSI "（递归自我改进）的想象空间。故事通胀的背后，是大多数团队的底子撑不起叙事的升级，每次风口转向，就得重新攒一套说辞。资本也随之变得挑剔，同样的 BP，去年能融到，今年连会都约不上。（雷峰网）但 RoboScience 机器科学的节奏完全不同，逆势不断受到资本青睐，也因此成为具身领域里一个值得研究的样本公司。回看机器科学过去五轮融资的时间点，几乎每一轮前后，都有可验证的产品技术落地：ICRA 最佳论文、仿真平台 RoboMirage、通用具身大模型 Visics、与腾讯云共创的云端具身智能服务 EaaS、首款轮式仿人形通用机器人 REX G1 以及真实的项目落地。某种意义上，这意味着，具身市场的融资，不该是技术跟着融资的故事走，反过来，融资应该跟着技术的兑现走。在 AI 科技评论看来，这是本轮融资最值得关注的信号：具身智能的资本筛选标准，正在从"讲得动人"转向"兑现得动"。一家公司的融资节奏如果能与技术节奏对齐，说明它手里握着可以持续拿出来的东西。在 AI 科技评论看来，这跟创始人团队有着分不开的关系。01斯坦福双子星，如何撑起一家中国具身头部公司在中国具身行业，从占据头部公司的创始人学术履历已经能看出几条清晰的派系：清华系、伯克利圈、斯坦福圈等等。其中影响最深的，是斯坦福圈。银河通用王鹤、穹彻智能卢策吾、Hillbot 苏昊，RoboScience 机器科学的（）这些公司和创始人路线各不相同，但往上追，大多能追到同一个实验室，美国三院院士、几何计算学者 Leonidas J. Guibas 在斯坦福的组。同一条脉络上还有 OpenAI 研究员严梦媛、清华大学助理教授弋力。这不算偶然。斯坦福几乎是全球具身智能研究的策源地之一：李飞飞，作为 ImageNet 发起人，视觉与数据驱动范式的奠基者，Chelsea Finn 的 REAL Lab ，以及几何计算学者 Leonidas J. Guibas，以及国外头部具身公司 Pi 创始成员都来自斯坦福。2016 年前后，斯坦福 Leonidas J. Guibas 教授（美国三院院士 ）的几何计算组，聚集了一批华人学生，其中就包括王鹤、邵林和他们的师兄苏昊等。Guibas 教授组有一条相当一致的研究主线：3D 视觉出身，重点钻研操作泛化，相信抽象表征和仿真。邵林的个人轨迹几乎是这条主线的完整样本。2014 年邵林进斯坦福，他先在几何计算泰斗、美国三院院士 Leonidas J. articles.title: 具身下半场怎么打？智元用一场发布会，给出了自己的答案
articles.content: GPT-6之后，机器人公司还有价值吗？智元用2万台出货量背后的“Worken”算力账本回应。    作者丨齐铖湧    编辑丨岑   峰                                                                                                       2026年，具身智能赛道正在陷入一场前所未有的情绪焦虑。GPT-6 Astra展示出的具身控制能力，让"物理AI即将被AI击穿"的论调甚嚣尘上；负责感知与决策的S2层，正在以肉眼可见的速度被通用智能接管。行业里甚至出现了明确的路线分化：一批做模型的公司开始转型卖数据，"卖铲子"成了新的安全区。而在烈火烹油的显示场景中，哪怕今年中国机器人整机产量突破10万台，能真正在流水线上替代现实工作、替人类扛起KPI的确寥寥无几。所有从业者都在等一个答案：当通用大模型不断吞噬智能的上层，做机器人的公司，价值锚点到底在哪里？10月29日，上海世博中心，智元创新日（A.I. DAY），稚晖君、姚卯青、熊彦、王闯和他们的智元军团用两个多小时的发布会，给出了一套完整的回应。现场超1000名科研伙伴、开发者、商业伙伴与媒体参会，线上超50家媒体直播。AI科技评论认为，这场分享里，有非常多的干货和行业痛点，值得跟大家剖析：01Worken：稚晖现场造了一个具身新名词发布会开场，稚晖君先泼了一盆冷水。“中国今年机器人整机产量预计突破10万台，但我们也必须清醒：生产了多少台机器人，并不等于真实世界就多了多少生产力。”这句话说完，现场一片沉默。这也是AI科技评论在一些行业调研中发现的“行业幻觉”：量产的新闻满天飞，但真正持续投入生产力的寥寥无几。对此，智元给出的解法是一个全新的度量衡：Worken（有效智能工时）：Worken = 活跃机器人数量 × 自主工作时长 × 产出效能比三个乘数，各自藏着具身行业的三个痛点问题：宕机、离线、维护中的机器不算活跃；遥操作时段不计入自主工作时长。镜头前忙得团团转、镜头后站着三个手柄操作员的机器人，在这套算法下工时直接清零；产出效能比以一个标准工人的单位时间合格产出为1.0，干得比人慢就不达标。为解释这个概念，稚晖君串起了一段度量衡史：蒸汽时代看"马力"，电力时代看"千瓦时"，数字AI时代则是用"Token"度量思考量。他总结道：“token衡量机器思考了多少，Worken衡量机器行动了多少。”在AI科技评论看来，这个概念的提出，远比发布某个产品重要，它代表着资深从业者对这个行业的深度思考。大模型产业之所以能形成今天按量计费、按效果定价的商业闭环，token居功至伟。它让"智能"首次成为可定价交易的商品。而物理AI行业苦无度量衡久矣：买卖双方无法定价，资本算不清楚投入产出，Worken正是解开这个死结的关键。稚晖君没有仅仅停留在造新词上，现场他直接切出了实时工时看板：龙旗产线的上下料机器人、香格里拉酒店的服务机器人、长隆乐园的文旅机器人，每台机器当月贡献的有效工时实时滚动。他调侃了道：“上过班的朋友都填过工时，未来对机器人的服务，也要按Worken来计费。”同场，由中国信通院等权威机构联合编制的《2026具身智能产业创新报告》正式发布，Worken及相关部署态实例成功入选。度量衡刚发布，就已经有了权威背书。在AI科技评论看来，“从卖机器人到卖工时”，是理解智元全部商业逻辑的钥匙。当机器人按Worken计费，客户买的就不再是一台出厂即巅峰、逐年折旧的设备，而是一个持续进化的生产力单元。稚晖君的另一句话点明了资产属性的变化：“硬件会陈旧，但智能可以升值。”02六个月前出的题，这次交卷了对Worken的构思最早源于六个月前的APC2026智元合作伙伴大会。当时，智元创始人邓泰华断言：2026年是具身智能从"开发态"迈入"部署态"的元年。稚晖君则定调：“行业真正的分水岭，是从’卖

articles.content:

Abstract: Self-evolving agents rewrite a persistent state from feedback, but it is largely untested whether this lets them learn a rule nobody told them. An agent can also pass by writing down each correction as an exception, and its list then grows with every new rule. We introduce CLR-Bench, a Curriculum of Latent Rules benchmark. Each chain adds one hidden rule per level on top of the earlier ones. A rule acts on an opaque label that stands for a named grouping published on the Web, such as the founding members of an airline alliance. The task gives one example value, practice feedback reveals one more member and one non-member, and the test checks unseen members and similar non-members. articles.title: Beyond Plausible Prediction: Safety Sufficiency in Web World Models
articles.content:
arXiv:2610.40798v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Web world models increasingly predict the consequences of candidate actions before agents act, yet a plausible predicted future does not necessarily support the correct safety decision. In a matched human evaluation of 3,000 predictions from ten frozen open models, 86.1% are judged semantically plausible. However, several models exhibit highly asymmetric authorisation behaviour, combining low false-safe execution with poor recall of clarifiable ASK cases and a strong preference for BLOCK. This motivates safety sufficiency: whether a predictive interface preserves and exposes the policy-decisive information required to distinguish actions that may be EXECUTED, require clarification through ASK, or should be BLOCKED. We introduce SafeWebWorld, a benchmark for evaluating safety sufficiency across five web-safety domains through action-conditioned futures, policy-decisive evidence, and policy-conditioned decisions. articles.content:
arXiv:2610.40831v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: AI model marketplaces host providers with heterogeneous costs and capabilities. These differences create an opportunity for computational arbitrage (Olmedo et al., 2026), in which an intermediary purchases inference from a portfolio of models and resells it to users at a profit. While prior work empirically demonstrates the feasibility of computational arbitrage for small model pools, scaling it to large marketplaces requires arbitrage strategies that are both computationally tractable and inexpensive to identify and deploy. In this work, we formalize computational arbitrage as an allocation problem and prove that it is generally NP-hard. articles.content:
arXiv:2610.40883v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Voice-interactive large language models process both what a speaker says and how they say it, yet the two channels do not always agree. We ask whether that disagreement degrades speech emotion recognition. Mapping text and audio into a shared valence-arousal-dominance space, we convert the distance between them into a continuous, threshold-free incongruence score with a two-component Gaussian mixture, and validate the score against human judgement. articles.content:
arXiv:2610.40906v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Recent scientific agents build knowledge recursively by retrieving evidence, constructing an intermediate state, and judging whether that state contains sufficient information. These agents are evaluated end-to-end, usually without ground truth, so the effect of each design choice is unknown. articles.title: Towards Portable Specification of the Agent Harness
articles.content:
arXiv:2610.40917v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Large language models act only through the infrastructure that surrounds them. That infrastructure, the harness, determines what a model can accomplish and how it fails, yet it has no settled definition. To address this gap, we decompose the harness into eight functional components that can be specified and compared across systems, and we propose a portable specification framework that records which model ran in which harness. The record is needed because different harness configurations can yield several-fold differences in reported scores for the same model, and because much of an agent's attack surface lies in its harness. Existing model cards and agent cards provide release and operational information, but do not establish the sequence of effective configurations within a run. articles.content:
arXiv:2610.40927v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Test-time scaling (TTS) improves large language model agents by sampling and selecting among multiple candidate trajectories, but common realizations assume that these trajectories can be executed in parallel. This assumption breaks in realistic deployments, where enterprise workspaces and cloud services are shared and persistent, costly or infeasible to replicate, and actions may introduce irreversible side effects or cross-trajectory interference. articles.content:
arXiv:2610.40938v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Using customer conversations to train and evaluate financial language models raises confidentiality concerns because non-public financial facts can remain after direct identifiers are masked. Synthetic transcripts offer an alternative data source, but their discourse fidelity and residual confidentiality risks require assessment. articles.title: The First Few Tokens Matter: Understanding Chain-of-Thought Controllability
articles.content:
arXiv:2610.40939v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring is a promising way to oversee increasingly capable agents. It succeeds in part because current models appear limited in their ability to control what they verbalize in their reasoning traces. Abstract: LLM agents serve natural-language requests through tools, data sources, and other agents, and even simple requests often need several interdependent calls.
